we propose a multi-agent neural architecture search framework, MANAS, that achieves competitive performance with significantly reduced memory requirements and computational cost.

our method is a novel approach to the neural architecture search problem that achieves state-of-the-art performance while using much less computational resources than previous methods.

The main takeaway from our work is that
multi-agent learning is a powerful paradigm for addressing large scale search problems.
the multi-agent formulation of NAS is an effective way to reduce complexity, and that the resulting agents can learn to cooperate and coordinate to find optimal architectures.
